# Shared Project Context

## Tech Stack
- TypeScript monorepo (pnpm workspaces): `@officexr/world`, `@officexr/studio`, `@officexr/sdk`, `@officexr/realtime-server`, `@officexr/core-refactor`
- React + React Three Fiber (`@react-three/fiber`, `@react-three/drei`) for 3D canvases
- Rapier physics via `@react-three/rapier` (characters only; placed objects are static)
- Vitest for unit tests

## Test Infrastructure
- **Framework**: Vitest
- **Test command**: `pnpm --filter @officexr/world test` or `pnpm --filter @officexr/studio test`
- **File conventions**: `*.test.ts` / `*.test.tsx` alongside source files

## Conventions
- SOLID is baseline architecture — single-responsibility modules, open/closed strategy tables, DIP (SDK/world know nothing about THREE/React)
- Renderer primitives live in `packages/world/src/renderer/`; editor canvases *compose* them, never reimplement
- `import * as THREE` is only allowed in `packages/*/renderer/**` and canvas files (`SceneEditorCanvas.tsx`, etc.)
- No `import 'three'` or `import 'react'` in `packages/sdk`, `packages/realtime-server`, or `packages/core-refactor`
- `WORLD_OBJECT_KIND_DEFAULTS` / `normalizeKind` in `world-object-kinds-schema.ts` is the single place to declare per-field defaults for catalog entries
- `SOLID violation` comments must state which principle, why, and how to fix — see CLAUDE.md
